workItem: Restore the Supabase Auth CAPTCHA token contract for backend-first email registration/login/recovery/resend after live registration evidence showed CAPTCHA rejection before confirmation mail generation.
workItemDE: CAPTCHA-Token-Vertrag des backend-first E-Mail-Auth-Flows wiederherstellen, damit Supabase Registrierung, Login, Recovery und Confirmation-Resend akzeptiert
projectStage: PVC-02 Controlled Implementation / PVC-08 Production Operations
priorityReason: Production registration currently returns enumeration-resistant 202 while Supabase rejects the request before confirmation mail generation because captcha_token is missing.
dependencies: Frontend owner must obtain a fresh hCaptcha token through the existing src/lib/hcaptcha.ts bridge and supply it in the same-origin auth request.
Supabase Auth CAPTCHA remains enabled; this package does not disable or weaken bot protection.

evidence.smtpTest: Render mailer successfully completed outbox job e6f1a611-11a3-43b3-9f0a-20df0ae1c208 to s.kulessa@protonmail.com on first attempt.
evidence.registrationFailure: Render backend-auth log: captcha protection: request disallowed (no captcha_token found).
evidence.resendFailure: Render backend-auth log: Signup confirmation resend rejected for the same missing captcha_token.
evidence.existingBridge: src/lib/hcaptcha.ts already provides requestHcaptchaToken(); Dockerfile/render.yaml already project VITE_HCAPTCHA_SITE_KEY.
evidence.openWriterOverlap: No open auth/captcha/email registration PR at claim creation.

scopeBoundary: Do not expose hCaptcha secret; only the public site key remains browser-visible.
Validate captchaToken as bounded request input and fail closed when absent.
Forward captchaToken to Supabase signUp, signInWithPassword, resend and resetPasswordForEmail.
Preserve account-enumeration resistance for registration, recovery and resend.
No SMTP credential change is required by current evidence.
No database schema or Stripe mutation is part of this package.
acceptanceCriteria: All four protected backend email-auth endpoints require a bounded captchaToken.
Supabase calls receive captchaToken in their documented options contract.
Provider CAPTCHA errors no longer masquerade as a successful mail request when the token is absent at the backend boundary.
Existing email-confirmation token-hash flow and HttpOnly session behavior remain unchanged.
Focused and required checks pass on exact head.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
releaseReason: Superseded by fresh Human Owner direction to remove hCaptcha from the application after the login page froze again with the CAPTCHA runtime attached.
